title: HYCROFT MINING HOLDING CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Hycroft Mining Holding Corporation filed a Form 8-K announcing the appointment of Eric Colby as Executive Vice President, Corporate Development, effective April 16, 2026. Colby brings nearly two decades of mining industry experience and over $20 billion in transaction experience, having previously worked at Newmont Corporation and most recently at Magris Performance Materials.
key_points: Hycroft Mining appointed Eric Colby as Executive Vice President, Corporate Development on April 13, 2026 (effective April 16, 2026)
Colby's base salary is $450,000 per annum with an initial equity grant equal to 150% of base salary vesting over three years
Target discretionary bonus is 80% of base salary, with potential to earn up to 200% based on performance
Colby previously spent 15 years at Newmont Corporation in roles across corporate development, investor relations, and operations in South America
Most recently, Colby served as VP Operations at Magris Performance Materials from 2021-2025
The company filed this under Item 5.02 (Departure/Appointment of Directors) and Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure)
